[SWS_DM_00970] Behavior of failed data element retrieval
⌈
If the re-
trieval of the dataElement failed due to an external processor has an error of ara:-
:diag::DiagUdsNrcErrorDomain, the DM shall treat the DiagnosticEnvCondi-
tionFormulaPart as condition not fulfilled and trigger a Log and Trace message.
⌋
